scripts.assets: node ../../scripts/copy-engine-assets.mjs public/engine && mkdir -p public/fonts && cp ../../node_modules/dejavu-fonts-ttf/ttf/DejaVuSans.ttf public/fonts/
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply pdf-sdk-site --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.stats: wrangler d1 execute pdf-sdk-site --remote --command "SELECT name, SUM(count) AS uses FROM counts WHERE day >= date('now', '-30 day') GROUP BY name ORDER BY uses DESC"
scripts.errors: wrangler d1 execute pdf-sdk-site --remote --command "SELECT message, SUM(count) AS times, MAX(day) AS last FROM errors WHERE day >= date('now', '-30 day') GROUP BY message ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.feedback: wrangler d1 execute pdf-sdk-site --remote --command "SELECT at, browser, email, message FROM feedback ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50"
